mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM board_bookmark WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM board_bookmark WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, b.member_id, b.category, b.title, b.content, b.count, b.like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment bc WHERE bc.board_id = b.board_id) AS comment_count, b.create_at, DATE_FORMAT(b.create_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_at_str, b.update_at, m.nickname, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.profile, ''), '/images/common_member.png') AS profile FROM board_bookmark bb JOIN board b ON b.board_id = bb.board_id LEFT JOIN member m ON m.member_id = b.member_id WHERE bb.member_id = #{memberId} AND b.is_hidden = FALSE ORDER BY bb.bookmark_at DESC, bb.bookmark_id DESC
